plain: Land held by a church or group that never passes it on; the 'dead hand'.

webster.text: In law, possession of lands or tenements in dead hands, or hands that cannot alienate.

example.quote: To enable them in their corporate capacities to receive grants of land; and so far is against the laws of Mortmain.(1)
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Opinion on the Constitutionality of a National Bank, Feb. 15, 1791
